# Greenfield replay

Run `dotnet run --project src/Orchestrator.Cli -- run scenarios/greenfield.yaml --replay` from the solution root. Review Requirements, Design and Release.

This fixture re-emits the pinned Base62 generator and domain tests into the existing Phase 2 solution. It does not rebuild the entire product from scratch. It writes through FileChangeService and then runs the full solution build/test gate without restore.

Use the run directory for approved artifacts, decision lineage, audit JSONL and validation logs. Release is a readiness decision, not deployment.
